description.value: The Piper's is a neighbourhood pub-turned-restaurant on Hammond Bay Road in Nanaimo, originally established in 1977 and now relaunched under new ownership as 'THE PIPER'S EAT + DRINK + SOCIAL.' The menu is an eclectic fusion of West Coast, Korean, and Japanese-inspired dishes spanning brunch, all-day dining, a full café bar, happy hour, and a kids menu. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a wide-ranging meal option in a residential neighbourhood setting with a lively, social atmosphere.

address.value: 4700 Hammond Bay Road, Nanaimo, BC V9T 5B1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pipersnanaimo.com is live and detailed, confirming an active full-service restaurant/pub at 4700 Hammond Bay Road, Nanaimo with brunch, all-day, café, happy hour, and kids menus. The phone number (250-585-3020) matches OSM exactly; the OSM name 'The Piper's Restaurant' reflects older branding — the business now identifies as 'THE PIPER'S EAT + DRINK + SOCIAL' (originally The Piper's Pub, est. 1977, under new ownership). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site; vegetarian options are confirmed by menu items explicitly labeled 'VEGE' and 'VG'.
concerns: OSM name 'The Piper's Restaurant' does not match current branding 'THE PIPER'S EAT + DRINK + SOCIAL' (formerly The Piper's Pub); OSM may predate the rebranding under new ownership.

OSM opening hours (Mo-Sa 10:00-20:00) are outdated and inconsistent with website hours; website itself shows minor internal inconsistency (some pages list Sunday-Thursday as 10AM-9PM, others as 9AM-9PM).
OSM record has no street address; address sourced from website only.

Website subpage URLs contain Korean text (e.g. /복제-home), and the page title is in Korean ('파이퍼스나나이모닷컴'), suggesting the site was built on a Korean-language template — not a concern for validity, noted for awareness.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by an active website with full menus and current contact information. Straightforward include.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business is incorporated as 'YSY PIPERS RESTAURANT INC.' per the 2024 copyright footer. The Hammond Bay Road location places it in a residential neighbourhood on the north end of Nanaimo, away from the downtown core.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists vegetarian items including 'DUMPLING(VG or PORK)', 'THAI CAULI-PLANT', 'VEGE SPRING ROLL', 'MUSHROOM MEDLEY', and 'EARLY RISER' yogurt bowl; 'VG' label used on menu
